Retaining Wall Services Across Sydney Every Sydney block is different, and the right retaining wall depends on what is actually under your feet. On the sandstone ridges of the north shore and northern beaches, that usually means rock excavation and a wall system that suits the stone - concrete sleeper or sandstone block, battered back properly. On the shale-clay country through the inner west and western suburbs, drainage does most of the work: a well-built concrete sleeper or core-filled besser block wall, backed by real ag-drain and geofabric, handles the ground movement that a poorly drained wall cannot. A specialist who knows the difference will review your enquiry, and we explain the real cost and compliance picture before you commit to anything. Do I need council approval for a retaining wall in Sydney? It depends on height and site conditions. Under the Codes SEPP a wall is exempt development, no DA or CDC needed, only if it is 600mm or less and clears every other exempt-development standard: boundary setback, separation from other walls, drainage connection, distance from waterbodies and no heritage constraint. Anything that misses one of those conditions needs a complying development certificate or a development application. How much does a retaining wall cost in Sydney?
